scenario: LGRA.2.9.6.7 — `{{`/`}}` escaping applies in every string position, including ineligible ones: an escaped `{{path}}` in a `where`-predicate string is a literal brace, not an inert interpolation, so it compiles clean (no DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_INERT_POSITION). The comparison is against the literal `m-{s.obj}`. Pin: `where s.obj == "m-{{s.obj}}"`.
rules_ds:
schema Src scope logical:
    obj: String key

rule r:
    Src s where s.obj == "m-{{s.obj}}"
->
    log info "done"
